name: iron_absorption
description: Iron absorption teaching path with parallel non-haem and haem branches. Non-haem: Fe³⁺ reduction → DMT1 apical uptake → ferroportin export (hepcidin block). Haem: HCP1-like apical uptake → HO-1 releases Fe²⁺ into the enterocyte pool → same ferroportin exit. Ascorbate co-occupation favors the ferrous lumen pool. FLOW topology — magnitude bounds live in iron UNIT / laws.

references: Iron homeostasis / ferroportin regulation (lactoferrin model): PMID 39005063 (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39005063/).
DMT1 apical Fe²⁺ uptake — NCBI Gene SLC11A2: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/?term=SLC11A2
Ferroportin basolateral iron export — NCBI Gene SLC40A1: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/?term=SLC40A1
Hepcidin (HAMP) ⊣ ferroportin control point — NCBI Gene HAMP: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/?term=HAMP
Magnitude bounds live in iron UNIT / laws (Biology as Code).

nodes.label: Dietary non-haem Fe³⁺
nodes.notes: Label iron is not absorbed iron. Form + co-occupants matter.

nodes.label: Dietary haem iron
nodes.notes: Higher fractional absorption than non-haem; separate apical path.

nodes.label: Haem (enterocyte)
nodes.notes: Intact haem after apical uptake; cleaved by HO-1.

nodes.label: Fe²⁺ (lumen pool)
nodes.notes: Ascorbate / reducing surface expands usable ferrous pool.

nodes.label: Fe²⁺ (enterocyte)
nodes.notes: Cytosolic labile iron; shared by non-haem and haem branches.

nodes.label: Transferrin-bound Fe (plasma)
nodes.notes: Systemic transport form after basolateral export + oxidation.

nodes.label: Meal ascorbate (enhancer)
nodes.notes: Same-meal co-occupation gate — not daily average.

edges.notes: Fe³⁺ → Fe²⁺. Supported by reducing agents including ascorbate.
Teaching link: ascorbate expands ferrous pool (not a second substrate edge).
Apical haem uptake; higher fractional absorption than non-haem.
Cleaves haem → Fe²⁺ + biliverdin + CO; joins labile iron pool.
Export is the systemic control point for absorption (both branches).
Inhibitory teaching edge: high hepcidin lowers effective export.
